comment: pray.c pleased():1287-1303, the pat_on_head case 4 ('You are surrounded by a light blue aura.') that uncurses every cursed inventory object except a worn helm of opposite alignment (uarmh). A lawful human Valkyrie in debug mode on a full-moon date (+1 Luck) wishes for a helm of opposite alignment and wears it (it curses itself and makes her chaotic, wiping her alignment record), wishes for an uncursed luckstone (Luck +3, so Luck 4), creates a hostile soldier ant and #wizkills it and a grid bug for alignment record (+5 each, above STRIDENT), wishes for a chaotic altar on the square to the north, prays there and answers y to 'Force the gods to be pleased?', then lists her inventory: the helm is still cursed and nothing glowed amber. Seed 6602419 is the first of seeds 6602417-6602446 whose prayer reached case 4 (also 6602432 and 6602439). Date and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
